A Ghost in Your Ear

7:00 PM · Audible's Minetta Lane Theatre, Greenwich Village · ↻ Most days Going out

When an actor arrives late to a sound studio for a last-minute audiobook recording session, he is handed the script of a chilling ghost story to read. But as the engineer cues the recording and the evening wears on, the horrors slowly begin to escape the page to haunt the studio itself. Fresh from an acclaimed, sold-out run in London, A GHOST IN YOUR EAR is the "truly terrifying headphone horror" (The Guardian) from the darkly brilliant mind of Tony Award® nominee Jamie Armitage (SIX), made in collaboration with Ben and Max Ringham (ANNA, National Theatre). A mesmerizing blend of gothic horror and psychological thriller, this cutting-edge theatrical experience uses groundbreaking binaural sound technology to immerse every audience member in a haunting world of sound. And at Audible's Minetta Lane Theatre - one of New York's most intimate venues - there's no escaping the frights. Enter if you dare.

Alex Plain | Wonny Jane | On Parade

7:00 PM · Berlin, East Village · $13.22

Alex Plain invites you to a night of indie rock and folk anthems, with original material from himself and his good pal Wonny Jane, graciously hosted by Berlin Under A. Alex Plain puts forward a relentless and spontaneous energy that imbues his sets with a certain je ne sais quoi that can only truly be experienced live. idt he rightly ever knows what's gonna happen when he steps on stage, nor will he ever. He'd describe himself as a folk artist but his friends venture to say his music is like if jeff mangum and weezer had an ugly yet very talented baby. Wonny Jane is an up-and-coming indie rocker and songwriter blending rock, pop, and the occasional folk twang into a new, innovative, viral sound. Come to dance, hear his amazing talent, and find your new favorite earworm and get to say shit like "yeah i was into him before he blew up."
